prompts.name: cafe
prompts.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Final website hero for a friendly practical Japanese AI consultation and training service serving local small businesses. The user rejected abstract surreal sculpture and wants realistic, immediately understandable subject matter with only a little artistic flair.
Create an authentic editorial photograph of a Japanese woman small cafe owner in her late 30s and a casually dressed Japanese male advisor in his 40s sitting together at a warm bright cafe worktable. Both are fictional people, neither a famous or real identifiable person. Main visual story: they have just turned the cafe's coffee photo and rough handwritten idea into a finished promotional flyer using AI on a laptop. At center-right, laptop screen angled toward camera clearly shows a modest split-screen layout: a conversational AI chat on one side with subtle gray text-like lines, and on the other a clean visually appealing cafe flyer featuring the SAME latte and small butter cookie that are physically on the table. A printed copy of that same flyer lies nearby. The owner points at the flyer, the advisor listens; natural pleased expressions, not exaggerated advertising smiles. Show plausible hands and laptop, coherent matching photo/output. This is a real useful workflow, not futuristic technology. Laptop and output should dominate the foreground, people establish warmth behind them. Medium-wide eye-level 3:2 landscape crop, all important content within safe central area.
Beautiful but realistic daylight, generous airy composition, natural skin texture, tactile wood and matte paper. Warm off-white, a soft denim blue shirt, a small burnt-orange mug; a gently surprising editorial crop creates personality. Sophisticated small-business magazine photography, approachable and lively. No floating objects, abstract sculptures, neon lines, magic effects, robots, stock-office suits, complicated HUD, giant text, logos or watermarks. Do not add decorative 3D elements or doodles. Any incidental screen text should be small and unobtrusive; do not bake site headings into the image.

Bright inviting natural daylight, warm off-white, wood, soft denim blue and a little burnt orange. Landscape 3:2, clear focal point, generous composition. No logos or headline overlay.Three adults in their 30s to 60s in a small friendly workshop at a wooden cafe table, learning AI together. Screens contain a simple AI chat and a structured text document with small unobtrusive lines. Their hands and screens visibly show that they are practicing, not listening to a lecture. Medium-wide candid side angle; real notebooks and coffee. Faces readable, laptop work readable as a process, no large screen text.
